inputs.prompt: Exact 3 columns by 3 rows sprite atlas, nine simple colorful fantasy game UI pictograms on pure black background. No text no letters no borders. Equal square cells, generous margins, centered clean flat bold readable symbols. Row one: gold closed padlock, cyan open padlock, gold coin with small green sell arrow. Row two: orange crossed dismantling tools, green armor with check mark for equipped, blue armor with upward arrow for equip. Row three: red close X, violet two curved transfer arrows for inheritance, gold hammer and cyan gemstone for forge. Minimal details, vivid restrained colors, consistent scale, isolated symbols.
inputs.negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, deformed, extra limbs
